import copy,hashlib,json,logging,sys
from pathlib import Path
from types import SimpleNamespace
from gallery_dl import formatter,version
from gallery_dl.postprocessor.metadata import MetadataPP
from gallery_dl.path import PathFormat
class Job:
 def get_logger(self,n):return logging.getLogger(n)
 def register_hooks(self,*a):pass
class P(SimpleNamespace):
 def clean_path(self,s):return s
 def clean_segment(self,s):return s.replace('/','_')
 def build_filename(self,kwdict):return PathFormat.build_filename(self,kwdict)
cases=[]
for name,filename,ext,directory,keywords,options in [
 ('first_init',None,'','$ROOT/artist1',{'id':1,'num':0},{}),
 ('first_post',None,'','$ROOT/artist1',{'id':1,'num':0},{}),
 ('after_file','1_1.jpg','jpg','$ROOT/artist1',{'id':1,'num':1,'extension':'jpg'},{}),
 ('empty_next_post_retains_filename','1_1.jpg','jpg','$ROOT/artist2',{'id':2,'num':0,'extension':'png'},{}),
 ('empty_next_extension_format_rebuild','1_1.jpg','jpg','$ROOT/artist2',{'id':2,'num':0,'extension':'png'},{'extension-format':'{extension}.json'}),
 ('first_post_missing_extension_format',None,'','$ROOT/artist1',{'id':1,'num':0},{'extension-format':'{extension}.json'}),
 ('empty_next_missing_extension_format','1_1.jpg','jpg','$ROOT/artist2',{'id':2,'num':0},{'extension-format':'{extension}.json'}),
 ('first_post_extension_format','', '', '$ROOT/artist1',{'id':1,'num':0,'extension':'png'},{'extension-format':'{extension}.json'}),
 ('empty_next_custom_filename','1_1.jpg','jpg','$ROOT/artist2',{'id':2,'num':0},{'filename':'{id}_info.json'}),
 ('empty_next_root_base','1_1.jpg','jpg','$ROOT/artist2',{'id':2,'num':0},{'base-directory':True}),
 ('empty_next_literal_directory','1_1.jpg','jpg','$ROOT/artist2',{'id':2,'num':0},{'directory':'meta'}),
 ('empty_next_jsonl','1_1.jpg','jpg','$ROOT/artist2',{'id':2,'num':0},{'mode':'jsonl'}),
 ('uppercase_extension_source_retained','1_1.JPEG','JPEG','$ROOT/artist2',{'id':2,'num':0,'extension':'png'},{'extension-format':'{extension}.json'}),
]:
 pp=MetadataPP(Job(),copy.deepcopy(options));kw=copy.deepcopy(keywords)
 path=P(filename=filename or '',extension=ext,realdirectory=directory+'/',basedirectory='$ROOT/',prefix='',kwdict=kw,filename_conditions=None,filename_formatter=formatter.parse('{id}_{num}.{extension}').format_map)
 output=pp._directory(path)+pp._filename(path)
 cases.append({'name':name,'paths':{'directory':directory,'filename':filename,'extension':ext,'realpath':('$ROOT/artist1/'+filename) if filename else None},'keywords':keywords,'options':options,'filename_template':'{id}_{num}.{extension}','expected_path':output,'keywords_after':kw})
result={'version':version.__version__,'source':'Actual MetadataPP constructor/_directory/_filename/_filename_extfmt and PathFormat.build_filename. Synthetic public dictionaries and clean filename adapters; no file writes/network. $ROOT is a symbolic base directory.','source_sha256':{'metadata.py':hashlib.sha256(Path(__import__('gallery_dl.postprocessor.metadata',fromlist=['x']).__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'path.py':hashlib.sha256(Path(__import__('gallery_dl.path',fromlist=['x']).__file__).read_bytes()).hexdigest()},'generator_source':Path(__file__).read_text(),'cases':cases}
Path(sys.argv[1]).write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)+'\n');print(len(cases))
